Placemaker.Mode.Draw.Tooltip: Click corners to outline an area. Snaps to curbs, buildings, other areas and right angles.
Placemaker.Mode.Block.Tooltip: Hover a city block and click to take it. Shift+click adds neighbouring blocks.
Placemaker.Mode.Paint.Tooltip: Paint the area with a round or square brush. Right-click erases.
Placemaker.Mode.Perimeter.Tooltip: Click road intersections around the area; the roads in between are followed automatically.
Placemaker.Reason.NoArea: Draw, pick or paint an area first.
Placemaker.Reason.CloseArea: Close the outline: click the first corner again or double-click.
Placemaker.Reason.NoRecipe: Choose what this area should become.
Placemaker.Reason.StepNotReady: A layer of this design still needs something from you.
Placemaker.Reason.PlanErrors: Fix the problems listed in the review first.
Placemaker.Reason.AcknowledgePermanent: Confirm the permanent changes below before building.
Placemaker.Reason.BuildUnavailable: Building is not available right now.
Placemaker.Reason.GroupsUnavailable: Built areas cannot be managed right now.
Placemaker.Reason.PickBuilt: Click something Placemaker built to see, edit or remove it.
Placemaker.Problem.TooManyPoints: That is the most corners an outline can have.
Placemaker.Problem.NeedThreePoints: An area needs at least three corners.
Placemaker.Problem.TooSmallFor: Too small for this design (at least {0} m²).
Placemaker.Problem.TooLargeFor: Too large for this design (at most {0} m²).
Placemaker.Problem.NoBlockHere: No block could be found here.
Placemaker.Problem.NoRoadsNearby: No roads nearby. Use Draw or Paint here.
Placemaker.Problem.NotEnclosed: This spot is not enclosed by roads.
Placemaker.Problem.BlockTooLarge: This block is too large to pick. Use Draw or Paint.
Placemaker.Problem.NotAdjacent: Only blocks next to the selection can be added.
Placemaker.Problem.WouldEncloseHole: Areas cannot have holes: that would enclose a block you did not pick.
Placemaker.Problem.WouldSplit: Removing that block would split the selection in two.
Placemaker.Problem.PerimeterClosed: The loop is closed. Right-click to reopen it.
Placemaker.Problem.NoRoadPath: These intersections are not connected by roads.
Placemaker.Problem.NodeAlreadyUsed: The loop already passes through there.
Placemaker.Problem.SaveFailed: The design could not be saved.
Placemaker.Problem.CannotDeleteRecipe: Only your own designs can be deleted.
Placemaker.Problem.PresetSaveFailed: The preset could not be saved.
Placemaker.Problem.CannotRenamePreset: Only your own presets can be renamed.
Placemaker.Problem.CannotEdit: This area cannot be edited (its design was not stored).
Placemaker.Hint.DrawAddOrClose: Click to add a corner, click the first corner to finish
Placemaker.Hint.DrawEdit: Drag corners or edges to reshape
Placemaker.Hint.DrawInsertDrag: Drag to add a corner here
Placemaker.Hint.DrawInsertClick: Click: add a corner on the edge
Placemaker.Hint.DrawEdgeDragging: Moving the edge — release to place
Placemaker.Hint.BlockPick: Click a block to select it
Placemaker.Hint.BlockReplace: Click another block to select it instead
Placemaker.Hint.BlockAdd: Click: add or remove a neighbouring block
Placemaker.Hint.BlockRemove: Right-click a selected block to remove it
Placemaker.Hint.PerimeterAdd: Click road intersections around the area
Placemaker.Hint.PerimeterAddOrClose: Click the next intersection, or the first one to close the loop
Placemaker.Hint.PaintRotate: Move the mouse to turn the brush
Placemaker.Hint.MarkerPlace: Click on the outline to place a marker
Placemaker.Hint.MarkerRemove: Right-click near a marker to remove it
Placemaker.Hint.BuiltWithNotes: Built. {0} notes: some pieces were repaired or left out (marked on the map).
Placemaker.Hint.DefaultsSaved: Saved as the default for this layer.
Placemaker.Issue.PlanFailed: The layout could not be planned: {0}
Placemaker.Issue.PlanTimeout: Planning took longer than {0} s and was stopped. Try a smaller area.
Placemaker.Issue.KeptOffRoads: The area was trimmed to keep off existing roads ({0} m² left out).
Placemaker.Issue.AreaSplitByRoad: A road runs through the area: the largest part is used, {0} smaller part(s) ({1} m²) left out. Select them separately if you want them too.
Placemaker.Issue.BuildFailedNext: Red circles show where it went wrong. Adjust the outline or the settings and build again, or go back. The circles disappear as soon as you change something.
Placemaker.Permanent.Terraform: Reshapes the terrain permanently ({0} m²). Removing it later does not restore the ground.
Placemaker.Permanent.Water: Digs a permanent water basin ({0} m²). Removing it later does not restore the ground.
Placemaker.Settings.ClearExistingTreesAn: Removes trees, plants, props and decals inside the area when it is built, so nothing old pokes through. Buildings, utilities and roads are never touched.
Placemaker.Settings.RecoverRejectedPiece: If the game refuses some pieces, repair or leave out just those and build the rest. Placemaker tells you what was skipped.
Placemaker.Settings.OverlayPavedSurfaces: Paving, asphalt and plaza surfaces are drawn on top of grass instead of flickering with it.
Placemaker.Settings.ChargeNetConstructio: Roads and paths cost what the game charges for them, like when you draw them yourself.
Placemaker.Settings.SelectAsOneThing: Select and bulldoze as one thing
Placemaker.Settings.SelectAsOneThing.Des: Clicking any part of a built lot, park or plaza selects the whole build; bulldozing removes it all. Applies to new builds.
Placemaker.Settings.ConfirmBulldoze: Ask before bulldozing a whole build
Placemaker.Settings.ConfirmBulldoze.Desc: Shows the game's confirmation before a Placemaker build is bulldozed.
Placemaker.Settings.AutoExcludeCollision: When a few planned pieces collide with existing things, build the rest instead of refusing the whole area.
Placemaker.Settings.SurfaceClones.Desc: Lets planned ground surfaces show on top of road decals where they meet.
Placemaker.Settings.ParkingEconomy.Desc: Parking lots built with Placemaker charge a parking fee and count as parking in the city.
Placemaker.Settings.ExperimentalParkingC: Adds an invisible service building to parking lots so they show up in city statistics. Experimental.
Placemaker.Settings.CompanionUpkeepFacto: Multiplies the upkeep of the parking lot service building.
Placemaker.Settings.ShowCursorTooltips.D: Show what a click does and the area size next to the cursor.
Placemaker.Settings.PreviewDetail.Desc: Simple updates the preview when you let go of a slider or corner and hides small objects; Detailed updates continuously.
Placemaker.Settings.SnapToRoadsWhenDrawi: Corners snap to the edges of nearby roads. The other snapping options are in the game's snapping menu.
Placemaker.Settings.SketchSurfaceFill.De: The sketch preview shades planned grass, paving and water with a faint tint. Turn off to see only their outlines.
Placemaker.Settings.KeepOffExistingRoads: Drawn and painted areas stop at the edge of existing roads and sidewalks, so nothing is planned on the asphalt. Entrances move to the new edge.
Placemaker.Settings.LayoutSize.Desc: Scales the layout of every area type: path loops, spacing between benches and trees, plaza and feature sizes, margins. Trees, props and path widths keep their real size; parking stalls, roads, sports fields and golf greens keep real dimensions. 50% is the default; 100% is the original, roomier layout.
Placemaker.Settings.EdgeMargin.Desc: The one gap (in metres at 100% layout size) kept between the outline and paths or layout. Objects still keep their own footprint clear of the edge.
Placemaker.Settings.ToggleToolBinding.De: Opens or closes the Placemaker tool.
Placemaker.Settings.PrimaryBinding.Desc: Does what the main button says (next step, build…).
Placemaker.Settings.UndoBinding.Desc: Undo the last change to the area or design.
Placemaker.Settings.RemoveEverything.Des: Removes every park, plaza, parking lot and road area built with Placemaker in this city.
Placemaker.Settings.RemoveEverything.War: Remove everything Placemaker built in this city? This cannot be undone.
Placemaker.Settings.ResetDefaults.Desc: Resets these options and forgets the layer defaults you saved.
Placemaker.Settings.ResetDefaults.Warnin: Reset all Placemaker options and saved layer defaults?
